text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Breaking through the last 1,200 meters, Sakura Bakushin O trembles with delight at winning all three races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the way back home, I propose a new goal. In order to test the extent of her newfound growth, I ask Sakura Bakushin O to race against Nishino Flower in the Sprinters Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Bakushin O has been looking forward to a rematch with Nishino Flower, so she accepts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nonetheless, she doesn't fail to stress that this will be the last time she enters the Sprinters Stakes.
